scenarios.name: dfs-roundtrip
scenarios.notes: Delete the unused B.CONVERT utility through the original menu to free one slot in the full catalogue; save, change cargo, then reload E.TEST. Original source SSD stays unchanged.

scenarios.name: hyperspace-diso
scenarios.notes: Find DISO on the chart, launch, engage hyperspace and finish the countdown. Successful arrival and fuel expenditure are asserted on both independent machines.

scenarios.name: joystick-centre
notes: Pause with COPY, enable the analogue joystick with K, resume with DELETE and launch; all four physical analogue inputs remain centred and fire buttons released.

scenarios.name: joystick-motion-fire
notes: Buy a front pulse laser through ordinary keys before launch. Drive physical analogue channels and FIRE via ADC/VIA pins; check actual laser heat, movement, release, commander, universe, RAM, pixels, sound and disk.
Aligned analogue fixture retained for regression; arbitrary input patterns are covered by joystick-arbitrary-bits-fire under the declared bbc-result-bits reference profile.

scenarios.name: manual-docking
scenarios.notes: Launch from Lave, brake, turn and align with the station, approach slowly and return to docked status. Every action is a physical key; the route was discovered from passive observations, with no RAM/register injection or added equipment.

scenarios.name: cargo-capacity-roundtrip
scenarios.notes: Physical keys request nine textiles when the default eight-tonne hold is empty, then buy and sell one tonne. Assert refusal preserves credits/cargo/capacity and the completed sale restores them. No guest state is injected.

scenarios.name: encyclopedia-anaconda
scenarios.notes: CTRL-F6 loads released 1.E; choose Ships A-G and Anaconda through real key presses. The ship workspace selector must be card 1 and the encyclopedia view 32, with exact every-field rotation, memory, disc and sound comparisons.

scenarios.name: ecm-manual
notes: Buy ECM with the original equipment menu, launch and press E. Check actual player activation, energy drain and automatic expiry, independently of opponent ECM.

scenarios.name: missile-station-defense
notes: Buy ECM and one missile, use the rear view to lock onto the station, fire, and observe station ECM and the incoming Viper. Pressing E during the opponent countdown does not activate the player ECM.
The released game increments its tally for the ECM-destroyed player missile. Preserve that result; it is not proof of killing an enemy ship.

scenarios.name: collision-death-restart
notes: Follow a physical-key station approach but accelerate into the collision. Check the actual GAME OVER glyphs before debris obscures them, the commander title prompt, restart via N/SPACE, status and a second successful launch.
Text predicates compare screen memory to the pinned original MOS ROM font; view flags alone cannot establish destruction or restart.

scenarios.name: equipment-refusal
notes: Lave offers equipment items 1 through 6. Select unavailable item 7 (fuel scoops) without charging, buy ECM, then reject a pulse laser purchase with insufficient credits without changing equipment or balance. Menu numbering is one-based: 8 is the escape pod and 9 the hyperspace unit.

scenarios.name: courier-wrong-station
notes: Accept the original Elite-A special-cargo contract for Zarece after rejecting an unaffordable offer. A second active contract is refused. Physical-key launch and manual docking back at Lave halve the pending reward without paying it out.
This qualifies acceptance, duplicate refusal and the wrong-station penalty. Successful delivery at the destination remains separate coverage.

scenarios.name: police-collision
notes: A short rear-beam burst makes the station hostile; its pursuing Viper collides with the player. This does not establish a laser kill.

scenarios.name: police-legal-hyperspace
notes: Select Diso before launch, buy a rear beam laser and provoke the station. Its Viper collides with the player, raising legal status to 64 without a kill credit. Leave at full speed and complete a 3.6 LY jump; Elite-A reduces legal status to 59, rather than the classic Elite halving rule.

scenarios.name: laser-viper-kill
notes: Buy a rear beam laser, provoke the station, enable the joystick through COPY/K/DELETE and depart at full speed. Replay the fixed physical ADC/FIRE schedule discovered on the original game; no guest RAM, commander or expected-state injection.

The original Viper loses energy 43 to 12 to 4, then underflows to 253 and explodes at approximately 5800 units from the player. The kill tally increases from 0 to 1 with no player missiles or ECM. This proves a ranged laser kill rather than the collision-only route.
The released game still reports legal status 0 at the late checkpoints; preserve its timing and explosion processing rather than imposing a classic Elite expectation.

scenarios.name: shipyard-refusal-reset
notes: Accept the Orrere delivery bond, fit ECM, reject an unaffordable Gecko and repurchase the current Adder. Physical inputs only; equipment and the delivery contract are cleared without refunding their purchase costs.

scenarios.name: escape-pod-leesti
notes: Select Leesti, hyperspace there, enable the joystick and use the shorter frozen physical ADC/key schedule to navigate and dock. Buy the Adder escape pod for 200 Cr, launch and eject; the released game consumes the pod, refills fuel and returns the commander safely to the station. No RAM, commander, pixels or expected-state injection.

scenarios.name: checkpoint-beep
scenarios.notes: Save each backend’s own gameplay state at 559104 us, during the configuration beep, with every physical key released. The continuation proof also requires byte-exact agreement with uninterrupted execution.

scenarios.name: courier-delivery-orrere
scenarios.notes: Frozen physical-input courier route: accept Orrere offer 9 at Lave (64.2 Cr bond, 525.0 Cr reward), jump to Reorte, enable joystick and dock, halve the reward to 262.5 Cr, refuel for 8.8 Cr, jump to Orrere and dock for payment. No machine RAM is injected; both backends replay from their own verified released-game boot.

scenarios.name: ship-purchase-gecko
notes: Declared synthetic E.RICH commander loaded through normal guest DFS keys; all released game and ship files unchanged. Each backend boots independently on its own declared medium. Buy Gecko at Leesti using the original shipyard menu; observe price, fuel capacity and reset cargo/equipment. No RAM or cross-machine snapshot injection.

scenarios.name: galactic-hyperspace
notes: Buy the galactic hyperdrive at Leesti and physically launch/CTRL-H to galaxy 2. Assert consumed drive, rotated seeds, nearest arrival system, completed countdown and preserved fuel.
All released game and ship files unchanged; input medium declared and hash-bound. Both backends execute independent own boots and physical keys; no RAM or cross-machine state injection.

scenarios.name: hyperspace-unit
notes: Buy the Elite-A single-use hyperspace unit, launch and press TAB. Assert consumed unit, restored hold space, random-system arrival and no fuel expenditure.
All released game and ship files unchanged; input medium declared and hash-bound. Both backends execute independent own boots and physical keys; no RAM or cross-machine state injection.

scenarios.name: galactic-wrap-clear-record
notes: Declared synthetic commander starts in galaxy 8 with galactic hyperdrive, legal status128 and delivery525Cr. Normal guest DFS load, launch and CTRL-H wrap to galaxy1 and clear legal/delivery reward. This proves a boundary case, not seven previous played galaxy jumps.
All released game and ship files unchanged; input medium declared and hash-bound. Both backends execute independent own boots and physical keys; no RAM or cross-machine state injection.

scenarios.name: shipyard-leesti-purchases
notes: Normal DFS load of declared E.RICH, followed by all eleven choices offered at Leesti. Purchases execute original pricing and trade-in logic; multi-digit selections exercise 10 and 11. No RAM or cross-machine snapshot injection. Frozen outcomes come from original-only build/bbc/exploratory-leesti-shipyard/report.json, SHA256 f6e898be46551ca0c465005fa5b0f92d1964e35733ae084b2c889671030e4b25. Independent paired captures must pass before claiming RTL evidence.

scenarios.name: joystick-arbitrary-bits-fire
notes: Buy a front pulse laser, enable joystick input and launch through original physical keys. Drive all four channels with non-aligned bit patterns, fire, reverse both axes and return to centre.
Completed ADC result fields use the independently checked bbc-result-bits reference profile. Axis outcomes were frozen from actual execution of unchanged released game bytes before RTL comparison.

scenarios.name: joystick-reversal-settings
notes: Toggle Y and J through the original pause/configuration keys to cover all four combinations, physical analogue channels and both fire pins.
Assert observed axis values for all four Y/J combinations, actual first-button laser heat and second-button release behavior; original-only outcomes frozen before RTL suffix execution.
